shared_elements: carving on a tall upright slab/pillar-shaped field
relief images arranged on a vertical surface
animal forms (a quadruped in A; animal-head and hand signs within glyphs in B)
justification: Both are vertical monolithic slabs bearing low-relief imagery, and both include animal-derived forms (a profile quadruped over a smaller creature in A; zoomorphic heads and hands embedded in signs in B), but that is where the resemblance ends. A shows a few large, sparse, naturalistically posed animals on an otherwise blank field, whereas B is a dense, fully ruled double-column grid of about twenty-four compact, cartouche-framed composite sign blocks — an entirely different organisational and stylistic scheme.
